desc: Initiates a public or private channel-based conversation

token.desc: Authentication token bearing required scopes. Tokens should be passed as an HTTP Authorization header or alternatively, as a POST parameter.

is_private.desc: Create a private channel instead of a public one

name.desc: Name of the public or private channel to create

team_id.desc: encoded team id to create the channel in, required if org token is used

cannot_create_channel.desc: This channel is unable to be created.

invalid_name_maxlength.desc: Value passed for `name` exceeded max length.

invalid_name_punctuation.desc: Value passed for `name` contained only punctuation.

invalid_name_specials.desc: Value passed for `name` contained unallowed special characters or upper case characters.

missing_scope.desc: The calling token is not granted the necessary scopes to complete this operation.

name_taken.desc: A channel cannot be created with the given name.

restricted_action.desc: A team (workspace) preference prevents the authenticated user from creating channels.

canvas_disabled_user_team.desc: Canvas is disabled on user's team
